headline: 3 loan apps that lend money in 5 minutes banned by central government; found stealing personal data, delete them from your mobile right now
summary: The central government removed three loan apps from the Play Store for allegedly stealing photos and contacts while offering low-interest loans. Citizens were urged to delete them immediately.
why: Unregulated digital lending apps carry credit and data-privacy risks, and regulatory action against them shapes the fintech and consumer lending sector in India.
